details:
This seems to be an issue I cannot find ANY solution for, and I'm not the only one apparently.

To summarize, after I'm in an instance for about 30 minutes to an hour, my avatars (no matter which one I wear, optimized or not) will begin to look like they're moving at 5-10 frames per second compared to everyone else, but ONLY in the eyes of other people. From my view I'm moving just fine, but everyone else sees me like I'm moving in stop motion.

After even more time my mic will also start to cut out and eventually go completely quiet, again ONLY for people other than me. The issue can be worked around by rejoining the instance every 30 minutes, but I REALLY don't want to have to keep doing that as that can interrupt conversations, games, or cause instance ownership issues if I happen to host anything. This bizarre and apparently not entirely uncommon bug has prevented me from hosting events with my friends and I'm sick of it.

Is there ANY solution to this that anyone's found?

My specs are:

GPU: RTX 4070 Super (Previously RTX 3090, got the same problem on both)

CPU: 12th Gen Intel i9-12900KF

Baseboard: PRIME Z690M-PLUS D4

Avatar specs are irrelevant as this seems to happen -regardless- of what Avatar I end up using, no matter how optimized or bare bones.
title: I move slower and can't talk for everyone else but me after about 30 minutes to an hour in an instance.
